title: Sep 10 Results: When Your Command Deserts You
summary: Tough outing on Sep 10 - 2W-3L (40%) proves even good setups don't always work

content.value:
## The Box Score Doesn't Lie

Let me be straight with you - today was the kind of day that reminds me why pitching is called the most humbling job in baseball. We went 2-3, hitting just 40% of our picks. From the mound, you learn real quick that some days your stuff just doesn't play like you think it will. That's what happened here.

## Where We Missed Location

Three misses in a row to start the slate - that's like walking the bases loaded in the first inning. The Rays, Phillies, and Rangers picks all looked solid on paper, with confidence levels in the low-to-mid 50s. But baseball doesn't care about your confidence. The Braves, Astros, and Mariners all made us pay for leaving pitches over the plate.

The Phillies pick at exactly 50% was essentially a coin flip - and we called it wrong. As a pitcher, I learned you can't live on the edges when you're not sharp. Same principle applies here.

## What Worked: High-Confidence Situations

Here's the silver lining - our two highest confidence picks both came through. The Yankees at 61% and Pirates at 59% were games where we had stronger reads, and they delivered. That's like trusting your fastball when you know you've got your best stuff working.

When you have conviction - real conviction backed by the numbers and matchups - you've got to attack the zone. We did that on these two, and it paid off.

content.title: ⚠️ Tomorrow's Schedule
content.sub: Off day across MLB - time to review film and reset

content.value:
## The Between-Starts Mentality

No games tomorrow means it's a bullpen day for us - time to analyze what went wrong and what went right. In my pitching days, these off days were crucial. You'd watch film, adjust your mechanics, and come back stronger.

That 40% accuracy stings, but you can't let one rough outing define you. The key numbers to watch: our high-confidence picks (59%+ probability) went 2-0, while everything below that went 0-3. That tells me our model knows something - we just need to trust it more selectively.

See you when the schedule resumes. Time to refine the approach.
